disclaimer: Personal portfolio demo on synthetic data. Not financial, pricing or legal advice. The tool shows evidence and risk from past matters; a person decides the price.

inputs.cost_rates_note: PLACEHOLDER values for the demo only. Internal cost per hour by level is an input that finance must supply; these figures are invented and are not estimates of any firm's costs.
inputs.mapping: Synthetic export, shape A (four tidy files)

rules: Closed before 2026-01-01 (open matters are never comps).
Matters that closed abnormally (settled early, transferred, other) are excluded.
At least 8 comps are required before any figure is shown.

backtest.scope: Out of sample. Walk-forward back-test of every closed internal_investigation matter, each modeled only from matters that closed before it opened. Matched on matter type only (not this proposal's selection rules), minimum 8 comps.
backtest.headline: Costs shifted over time (later closes 1.57x earlier ones) and bands built from older matters missed. Restrict comps to recent closes and re-test.
backtest.verdict: Costs shifted over time (later closes 1.57x earlier ones) and bands built from older matters missed. Restrict comps to recent closes and re-test. At the P75 figure, 18 of 31 back-tested matters cost more; the band implies about 8. At the P90 figure, 9 of 31 back-tested matters cost more; the band implies about 3. Middle band: 9 of 31 inside P25 to P75 against a nominal 50%.

p75.text: At the P75 figure, 18 of 31 back-tested matters cost more; the band implies about 8.

p90.text: At the P90 figure, 9 of 31 back-tested matters cost more; the band implies about 3.

distribution.basis: Normalized value: hours worked x the 2026 rate card, after any hours-reduction assumptions.

ai.label: User assumptions, not predictions. The tool does not estimate any effect of AI on hours.

scenarios.label: Fixed fee $100,000
notes: Revenue is the fee on every comp, whatever the work turned out to be.
scenarios.in_sample_note: In sample: counted on the same comps the bands were built from.

out_of_sample.text: Fee is nearest the comp P50 ($87,200). Walk-forward: 8 of 31 back-tested matters came in at or under their predicted P50; the band implies 50%.

scenarios.label: Capped fee, cap $130,000
notes: Billed hourly at standard rates up to the cap; work above the cap is not paid.
scenarios.in_sample_note: In sample: counted on the same comps the bands were built from.

out_of_sample.text: Fee is nearest the comp P75 ($127,500). Walk-forward: 13 of 31 back-tested matters came in at or under their predicted P75; the band implies 75%.

assumptions.text: The 10 comps above the P75 cost $133,000 more on average than the other 31. Discovery and diligence accounts for 47% of that gap ($61,900). Set a scope limit or a separate fee for that phase.

4 matters of this type closed abnormally (settled early, transferred or other) and are not in the comps. The figures assume the matter runs to completion; say what happens to the fee if it ends early.
The phase split for 3 of 41 comps comes from the date-window fallback, not task codes. Treat per-phase figures as lower confidence; totals are not affected.

Across the 41 comps, 5.3% of worked value was written down before billing and 2.9% of invoiced fees was not collected. A fee built from billed amounts would understate the work; the figures here use worked hours.

Comps that closed in the later half (n=21) cost 1.57x those in the earlier half (n=20) at the same rates (medians $105,200 and $67,000). Older comps may no longer be representative; consider the closed_within_years rule.
